decision.next_gate: Replace or densify the 29-cube Status-M-to-spectral-printer stage, rebuild both observers from the same direct authority, and prove shadow error falls below 0.001 D without changing the midscale by more than the same tolerance. Only then return to the V81/V82/V83 finite-event covariance gate.
decision.reason: The covariance envelope cannot identify which legal covariance belongs to 5279. Separately, the shadow spectral-LUT error is large enough to justify a new precision implementation, but that implementation must pass a direct-spectral equivalence gate before it can change released pixels.

lattice_resolution_boundary.interpretation: Both stages are continuous trilinear interpolation, not code-value quantization. The 193 cube cannot recover curvature already approximated by the upstream 29-cube joint spectral inversion.

measurement_authority.known: three marginal variances at each published exposure
measurement_authority.quantity: Status-M RMS diffuse density by record
measurement_authority.unknown: cross-record covariance, cross-power spectra, joint tails and stock-specific finite-event law

method.covariance_domain: all positive-semidefinite 3x3 correlation matrices with unit diagonal; this is a mathematical outer envelope
method.elliptope_solution: linear support optimized on the exact rank-two boundary of the 3x3 correlation elliptope; scalar rows also carry closed-form Gram-vector bounds
method.not_modelled: frequency-dependent cross-spectrum, DIR event feasibility, non-Gaussian tails and spatial observer MTF
method.observer_linearization: symmetric finite-amplitude secant of the deterministic local density mapping in linear Rec.709; both mean and formed density move, and each record's step equals its own published one-sigma density RMS
